paper_metadata.title: Research on Financial Stock Market Prediction Based on the Hidden Quantum Markov Model

experiments.description: Hidden Quantum Markov Model stock-trend forecasting using evenly discretized continuous stock data, evaluated on 15 SSE/SZSE stocks over 90/180/360-day horizons and compared against classical HMM.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: DA converges; training considered complete when DA stabilizes after about 40 iterations
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initial density matrix rho0 manually set; Kraus operators initialized from prior configuration

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Continuous stock data are discretized into 6 observation states using fixed threshold bins before HQMM training
problem_formulation.objective_function: Maximize log-likelihood ς = ln tr(K_Sn ... (K_S1 rho0 K†_S1) ... K†_Sn)
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Kraus operators constrained by sum_m K†_m K_m = I; optimization transformed to Stiefel-manifold constrained problem
